summary: Edge Manager generates self-signed certs in /etc/flightctl/pki (ca.crt/key, client-enrollment.crt/key, server.crt/key); replace server.crt and server.key with your own, put a custom CA for AAP auth at /etc/flightctl/pki/auth/ca.crt, and adjust insecureSkipTlsVerify accordingly.
questions: Where are Red Hat Edge Manager certificates stored?
How do I use my own server certificate for Edge Manager?
Where do I put the AAP CA certificate for Edge Manager?
